title: Executive summary distillation
description: Distills a long source into an executive-ready summary with evidence, decisions, risks, and actions.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: executive-summary-distillation
  title: Executive summary distillation
  description: Distills a long source into an executive-ready summary with evidence, decisions, risks, and actions.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce an accurate executive summary without losing material caveats.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - executive-sponsor
  nodes:
    - id: source
      kind: input
      name: Source document and audience
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - audience
          - length
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: extract
      kind: agent
      name: Extract material content
      role: Senior analyst
      prompt: Identify decisions, key findings, evidence, metrics, risks, dependencies, and unresolved issues with source
        references.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - extract
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: draft
      kind: agent
      name: Draft executive summary
      role: Executive communications writer
      prompt: Create a concise audience-appropriate summary with headline, implications, decisions needed, risks, and next
        steps.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: fidelity
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Verify source fidelity
      role: Independent reviewer
      prompt: Return passed only when the summary is accurate, balanced, and includes material caveats.
      config:
        threshold: 0.9
    - id: revision-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Bounded revision loop
      config:
        body:
          - draft
          - fidelity
        exitCondition: fidelity.passed == true
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: executive-sponsor
      kind: approval
      name: Executive sponsor approves summary
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Executive summary with source traceability
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: source
      to: extract
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: extract
      to: draft
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: draft
      to: fidelity
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: fidelity
      to: executive-sponsor
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e5
      from: fidelity
      to: revision-loop
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e6
      from: executive-sponsor
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: revision-loop-exit
      from: revision-loop
      to: executive-sponsor
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: revision-loop-exhausted
      from: revision-loop
      to: executive-sponsor
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
